(2) A man wearing a black t-shirt and grey shorts enters the frame from the left. He is smiling widely and pointing at the woman, appearing to speak energetically. He leans in close to her, his hand gestures animated as if telling a story or a joke. (3) The scene cuts between close-ups of the man's expressive face, showing wide eyes and an open mouth laughing, and the woman's increasingly bewildered then amused facial expressions. Yellow subtitles and cartoonish variety-show graphics appear as overlays to emphasize the interaction. (4) A transition occurs to a kitchen or dining area where the woman is shown holding a pink water bottle and a small orange packet of 'My Health Diary' enzyme. She is smiling broadly at the camera, looking refreshed. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or well-lit home. (5) A montage follows showing the man eating pizza and fried chicken in a living room setting, then consuming the supplement. The video concludes with a group shot of three people sitting on a sofa, holding product boxes and giving enthusiastic thumbs-up gestures toward the lens.
